text:
Sam (acct_exec): Heads-up: Neptune Health POC kickoff next Tue. They want streaming SDK + function/tool calling, structured JSON output, and SSO. Also asking for a rough pricing estimate and answers to a security questionnaire. Can SEs/solutions help coordinate?
Maria (sales_engineer): I can take lead on the SDK + streaming part. Do we have example wiring for their edge connector (they're using a Go microservice behind a proxy)?
Ivan (solutions_engineer): Yep — main constraints: keep latency <250ms p50, burst to 200 qps, and support structured tool outputs (JSON schema). We should propose hosted API for fast start and Dedicated if they need predictable throughput.
Maria (sales_engineer): For Go SSE client we usually recommend our lightweight SDK + handshake via short-lived creds. Example snippet we send:```go
client := redwood.NewClient("API_KEY")
stream, _ := client.Stream(ctx, StreamOptions{Model: "redwood-large-v1"})
for ev := range stream.Events() {
  // parse event and handle function calls
}
```
Maria (sales_engineer): For tool calling/structured output, suggest using the FuncJSON contract (we send schema and examples). Example output payload we show customers:```json
{"action":"upsert_patient","args":{"id":"1234","name":"Jane Doe","conditions":["hypertension"]}}
```
Katie (security): From the questionnaire side: they'll ask about SOC2, data residency, IP allowlist, SAML SSO, KMS integration, and logs retention. We can provide our standard security pack but need their expected retention and whether they want customer-managed keys.
Sam (acct_exec): On pricing they asked about a POC-friendly rate — small committed block vs pay-as-you-go. Any suggestion for a 2-week POC (approx 500k tokens)?
Maria (sales_engineer): For 500k tokens, estimate ~ $X on hosted with streaming; offer a temporary promo rate or a small committed min for POC. I'll draft numbers with Sarah in pricing.
Ivan (solutions_engineer): Technical blocker to flag: if they terminate TLS at a proxy, our SSE client needs websocket fallback. Also if they require on-prem, we need to brief infra for Private deployment timeline (~4-6 weeks).
Sam (acct_exec): They mentioned SAML SSO with IdP initiated flow and SCIM for user provisioning. Any docs?
Maria (sales_engineer): Link to runbook for SAML + SCIM: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/saml-scim (note: internal link). Quick checklist: metadata xml, callback URL, attribute mappings, cert rotation window.
deploy-bot: Runbook created: sales/3101122334-poc-runbook (ops ticket #RF-4321) :white_check_mark:
Katie (security): For the questionnaire items I need contact at Neptune to confirm network topology and data flow. Also ask if PHI will be in the POC — that changes KMS / on-prem considerations.
Ivan (solutions_engineer): Action items: Maria -> SDK demo + example structured outputs (by Fri). Katie -> draft security answers and highlight PHI implications (by Fri). Sam -> confirm expected QPS and whether PHI included (today). I'll prepare a short architecture diagram for the POC.
Sam (acct_exec): Good. I'll ping the customer for PHI and QPS. Thanks all — let's sync Thu 10am to align demo script. :thumbsup:
Maria (sales_engineer): I'll assemble a minimal demo repo (Go + Node examples) and a short README showing handshake, streaming, and function call parsing. Will include curl samples for quick validation.
Ivan (solutions_engineer): If they need structured schema validation, suggest adding a lightweight JSON-schema check in the client to fail-fast on malformed tool outputs.
Katie (security): Putting stakeholder list in the ticket and request for their security contact.
Sam (acct_exec): Perfect — keeping thread here. If anything blocks, tag @Maria or @Ivan.
